declarations.docstring: The projective dimension of a module, valued in extended natural numbers.
An auxiliary extended-natural-valued invariant of a module used to characterize projective dimension.
For a nonzero module, the projective dimension equals the auxiliary module invariant.
A module has projective dimension zero exactly when it is projective.
A zero module has projective dimension zero.
The projective dimension is at most a natural number exactly when the module has projective dimension bounded by that number.
Zero is at most the projective dimension of every module.
For a nonzero module, zero is at most the auxiliary module invariant.
